reviews.text: Chip and his whole team were nothing short of amazing with our 5 month old mini goldendoodle puppy! Communication was top notch, and our pup came home looking so fresh and tidy. Highly recommend their services for other dog owners. We'll definitely keep coming back for her future haircuts!

Been going to Animal Lovers for a few years now since my little fluff ball pom was born.  Chip and team do a fantastic job.  I used to live down the street and moved across town, and although I have places a block or two away, I make it a point to go back to Animal Lovers each month.  I'm sure my little guy is a handful but he comes back looking great every time!   Chip and Dani are super responsive, great at communication, and very accommodating.

Would recommend 100%

Thanks team!
literally the best! so blessed we are able to be taken care of by animal lovers :)

I absolutely love Animal Lovers Pet Salon!

They always do a thorough job with my short hair dog and her nails always look great. It is a bit on the more expensive side, but you do get what you pay for with the care for your pet, with the quality of the products and with the work done. (also love the flowers that they give with the groom)

I take my literal child here (my dog), so I of course would recommend this groomer to anyone looking for a top tier groom for their pet.

They really are animal lovers here! They take such great care of our dog Brady that every time we go back he’s pulling so hard to go inside because he’s so excited to be back. They do the best grooming job out of anyone else we’ve gone to in Chicago, by far.

Great for cats!!! My boyfriend and I brought our sweet baby boy Moon here after he had a bathroom accident while with a cat sitter. We were very nervous, as he has never gotten a hair cut or been in an animal salon before. He is squirmy and scares easily. We watched through the window as his groomer took him out of his carrier, and we had never seen Moon so calm in his life! The groomer handled him so well and even groomed him right in front of the window so we could watch and help ease our nerves. Moon got his sanitary cut and it took less than 5 minutes! We are extremely impressed and so thankful for the man who helped our Moon feel better. I cannot recommend this place enough and I will absolutely bring Moon back for next time! Thank you!

We LOVE Animal Lovers!! Chip has been grooming my dogs for many years. He and his team always do a great job, are professional and get my dog in and out as quickly as possible! I have an Aussie who sheds constantly, Chip came up with a game plan for my dog for the summer to manage her thick coat, keeping her comfortable and maintaining my sanity with the shedding!! Scheduling is always a breeze  and very accommodating. I also love the cute little collar bling they always add 😍
There isn’t anyplace better in all of Chicago!
We’ve been taking our dog there for a year now, amazing grooming and customer service. Our dog look great every time we take him there, and most importantly, Mishmish loves them.
Thank you for your review and patronage.

Animal Lovers is the best groomers in Chicago! We’ve been using their services for 2 years now. Chip and all the staff are so caring towards the dogs. They are super flexible if needed and very kind and caring. Their services for dog groming are top quality. Our dogs have never had better cuts. They’re truly talented and the best people. I wouldn’t even consider another groomers in Chicago.

They were awesome with my kitty for nail clipping. It took two visits and two people to hold her to get all four paws done, but Chip and his colleagues were very understanding and sweet. Definitely going there again :)

7 amazing years with ALPS! I have a double coated breed which are difficult to groom properly without damaging both coat layers but ALPS does it perfectly every time. My guy does not like to be groomed but ALPS are flexible and patient and treat him well every time. Thank you from Tom and Drogo! 🐾 …
Chip and his team do a fantastic job! They are great with my anxious Loqui and I trust them with her care. I recommend them.
